- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1066-1078 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The two list entries are not deduplicated. When trusted "failed for" and "cancelled/timed out for" comments name the same run ID, the loop processes that ID twice in one poll. On the empty-lookup miss path the ID is not added to CLARIFY_FAILURE_CHECKED_ID until the counter reaches 3 (line 1075), so the second iteration increments the miss counter again and prints "still waiting" again.
  WHY: The 3-try budget is used up in 2 polls. If the run becomes the newest scoped Clarify run on the skipped poll, the clarify_failed fail-fast window is missed and the step ends with status=timeout. The trigger is narrow but constructible, for example a re-posted failure plus a cancellation for the same run.
